title: Outlasting Endurance
description: To advance Minecraft's overworld and progression. A mod created to change the overworld in vanilla ways.
body:
Outlasting Endurance is a mod to advance the overworld, and bring the satisfaction of progress and exploration in vanilla ways. This mod adds 33 new mobs, functional blocks and items, such as a mortar and pestle, rope, fishing nets, etc... It revamps biomes like the plains, desert, and jungle, adds new plants, stone types, world generation features, new food, and much more.
On joining a world for the first time, you are able to obtain a starter manual. This will help you through the features of this mod, and help you progress and survive. You will also need to keep track of your thirst, alongside your hunger.

Any Bugs, Recommendations, ways to cheat the system? let me know in the comments below or on twitter!
